summary.text: Ben Robbins is a Republican state representative from Alabama House District 33 who took office in January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. His career experience includes owning Ben Robbins Law.

paragraphs.text: Robbins assumed office in the Alabama House on January 26, 2021.
In the 2025-2026 session Robbins was vice chair of the Boards, Agencies and Commissions Committee and a member of the House Judiciary Committee.
